rules: Every internal core capability is mapped to >=1 public consumer ID; exceptions must be explicit.
Every public consumer ID has >=1 registered provider internal candidate.
Every aggregate public contract has >=1 candidate; do not demand a single-provider standalone resolve.
Every internal candidate has normalized topic, resource, physical, source, observation, time and coverage metadata.
No extension/internal-only services claimed to be core public IDs; private extension boundaries remain separate.
Static graph coherence does not prove runtime provider availability, network health or individual data tile downloads.
